items.t: Turbo oil feed pipe can leak and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace left turbo oil feed pipe under recall

items.t: Starter solenoid can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Install starter relay kit under recall

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel pump under recall

items.t: Fuel can leak at the fuel rail connection (recall)
items.job: Tighten or replace fuel pipe under recall

items.t: Sudden braking from Highway Drive Assist radar (recall)
items.job: Replace front bumper beam under recall

items.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
items.job: Instrument cluster software update

items.t: Front seat belt anchors can come loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reinforce or replace seat belt anchors

items.t: Seat belt pretensioners can throw metal fragments (recall)
items.job: Replace seat belt pretensioners under recall

items.t: Windshield or rear glass may not be bonded properly (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield and rear glass under recall

items.t: Oil leaks from turbo lines or engine seals
items.job: Replace turbocharger oil line
items.note: RepairPal lists turbo oil line replacement at about $800-$1,130. A leaking turbo seal costs far more.

items.t: Repeated overheating and thermostat failures
items.job: Replace thermostat (water pump if needed)
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,030-$1,710 for a thermostat and $1,060-$1,470 for a water pump on 2017-2020 cars.

items.t: Car goes completely dead or won't start
items.job: Test charging system and replace 12-volt battery
items.note: Wiring repairs for water damage cost more.

items.t: Tires wear out early, blow out or vibrate
items.job: Wheel alignment (tires extra)
items.note: A set of four tires for this car adds several hundred to over a thousand dollars.

items.t: Self-leveling headlights aim too high or too low
items.job: Replace headlamp leveling control module
items.note: Sometimes only a recalibration is needed.

items.t: Center screen or backup camera goes black
items.job: Diagnose display and camera system
items.note: RepairPal lists body control system diagnosis at about $60-$90. A new head unit or camera costs much more if out of warranty.

items.t: Total electrical shutdown with doors locked
items.job: Diagnose electrical system and replace 12-volt battery if weak

items.t: Brief delay in throttle response after stops
items.job: Replace fuel pump
items.note: Only if the pump is at fault. Covered free if the car is in the fuel pump recall.

items.t: Seat memory or easy-exit feature stops working
items.job: Replace power seat switch

items.t: Wi-Fi, navigation or connected services stop working
items.job: Diagnose and update infotainment software

items.t: Driver attention alert goes off for no reason
items.job: Diagnose and update driver monitor software

items.t: Tire pressure display missing from the dash
items.job: Diagnose and update cluster software

items.t: Rodents chew through engine wiring
items.job: Repair or replace chewed wiring harness
items.note: One owner reported about $14,000 for airbag wiring. Comprehensive insurance often covers it.

items.t: Dark patches in the headlight beam
items.job: Inspect headlights; replace headlamp module if faulty

items.t: Steering sticks or lane assist pulls too hard
items.job: Diagnose steering and lane-keeping system

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out
items.job: Diagnose electric power steering system
items.note: Parts cost extra if the steering rack or motor must be replaced.

items.t: False crash warnings and sudden automatic stops
items.job: Diagnose and recalibrate front collision sensors
